Upload an icon

Add an SVG to the review grid. It starts as Ready, waiting for a reviewer to approve or disapprove it.

Read the upload guide ↓

Upload API · no login required

Production endpoint: POST https://suffered-scored-nicole-default.trycloudflare.com/api/icons/upload

Send JSON with name, family, and the SVG file contents in svg. Optional category defaults to manual_upload. The result has type uploaded and status Ready.

Run this working example in your terminal:

curl --fail-with-body --request POST 'https://suffered-scored-nicole-default.trycloudflare.com/api/icons/upload' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "Circle outline",
  "family": "solo",
  "bypass_validation": true,
  "category": "shapes",
  "svg": "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 48 48\"><circle cx=\"24\" cy=\"24\" r=\"16\"/></svg>"
}
JSON

For your own file, save a JSON payload with its SVG contents as payload.json, then call curl --fail-with-body -X POST 'https://suffered-scored-nicole-default.trycloudflare.com/api/icons/upload' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @payload.json.

Upload guide

  1. No login required. Select one SVG file up to 1 MB. A preview appears and the file name fills in the icon name.
  2. Check the name and family. The page detects the family from a supported SVG canvas. Its viewBox must match the selected family.
  3. Choose a category. Choose an existing category or type a new one, or leave it blank to use manual_upload. Every uploaded icon gets the uploaded type, including icons with a custom category.
  4. Select Upload to Ready, then Review uploaded icon to find it in the Ready queue.
  5. A reviewer chooses Approve to include it in the approved library, or Disapprove when it needs a fix and records feedback.
Supported SVG canvases
FamilyCanvasSVG viewBox
Sub32 × 320 0 32 32
Solo48 × 480 0 48 48
Container64 × 640 0 64 64

Preparing the file: Export static vector shapes and convert text to outlines. Scripts, embedded raster images, external resources, and unsupported effects are rejected. The SVG must contain visible artwork.

After upload: The icon starts as Ready. Guest uploads are attributed to anonymous; signed-in uploads record the account name. It stays saved through server restarts and gallery rebuilds. Uploading the same name again creates a separate icon. To revise an existing upload, open its inspector and use Editing → Manual Edit; save the revision, then review it in Pick.

API reference

Send POST /api/icons/upload with Content-Type: application/json — no login, API key, or session cookie is required. Browser requests must come from the same origin.

{
  "name": "Circle outline",
  "family": "solo",
  "bypass_validation": true,
  "category": "shapes",
  "svg": "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 48 48\"><circle cx=\"24\" cy=\"24\" r=\"16\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"black\" stroke-width=\"4\"/></svg>"
}

name, family, and svg are required. The name allows up to 120 characters. The optional category allows up to 100 characters; omitted, empty, or whitespace-only values become manual_upload. A supplied category is trimmed and preserved. The server assigns icon_type: "uploaded" automatically.

bypass_validation is a JSON boolean, default true. Set it to false to run rendered hole-and-pinch checks. Failed validation returns 422 with a validation report and does not save the icon; checker errors return 503. Passing uploads still enter Ready for human review. Safety, canvas-size, and rendering checks always run. This does not validate authored primitive grids, keyshape fit, vector spacing, or geometry symmetry; those require authored geometry. The saved record includes the validation report.

A successful request returns 201 with {"status": "ready", "record": {...}}. The record includes the icon key, category, type, preview URL, and SVG version hash. Errors return an error message: 400 for invalid fields or SVG, 413 for an oversized request, or 503 when storage or rendering is unavailable.

Review decisions require a logged-in reviewer and use POST /api/reviews with the returned icon key, svg_sha256, and status set to approve or disapprove. Disapproval is stored as pending in the API and shown as Disapproved in the app.
